The checkouts next to this one win when they are there, symlinked, so editing dpress
is editing this site. The pattern is a brace glob on purpose: a path repository whose
directory is missing is a hard error, but one whose *glob* matches nothing is simply
empty - so on a server the three below it answer instead, from the tags.
All three have to be named here. Composer only reads `repositories` from the root
package, so the ones inside dpress's own composer.json are ignored once dpress is a
dependency, and micro would be looked for on Packagist, where it is not.
